2022-2023.name: Advisory board
2022-2023.description: When the board is at loss about what to do, the Advisory board saves the day! This committee consists of old board members and, who would have thought, advises the board.

2022-2023.name: Almanacie
2022-2023.description: If you do not know how to klaverjas or do not know the meaning of a certain word, you can look it up in our almanac. However the last one was published nearly five years ago and thus it is time to work on a new one! This is what this committee is doing right now so that a new one can be published in 2023.

2022-2023.name: AP Committee
2022-2023.description: This committee is not only a lot of fun but also looks good on your CV. The members of this committee give feedback to the program directors about courses, organise the bi-weekly coffee hours and also the famous Applied Physics Dinner where members can enjoy a lovely meal with their professors.

2022-2023.name: Audit Committee
2022-2023.description: The Audit Committee helps out the Treasurer of the association. They the financial plan and updates and make sure everything is allright. This committee exists only of (old) board treasures.

2022-2023.name: Borrelcie
2022-2023.description: You must have been at one of our borrels before, the Borrelcie organises eight borrels a year. Additionally they keep the fridge full and order food every week so you can always streep your favourite snack!

2022-2023.name: Brouwcie
2022-2023.description: You can streep Gebouw 13 in the room. This lovely drink is the home-brewed beer from the Brouwcie! Every batch is a new delicious flavour so feel free to try one after four.

2022-2023.name: Buixie
2022-2023.description: Every year you can sign up for the Buixie trip where you get to travel to another country! The Buixie organises this trip and makes sure that there are educational and fun activities planned for the entire week.

2022-2023.name: Cheescie
2022-2023.description: The Cheescie has regular meetings where they make Cheese. It is a new committee that exists of people who love... cheese of course! Hopefully there will be a few occasions where you can try our delicious cheese.

2022-2023.name: Compucie
2022-2023.description: If you ever have trouble with the computers in the room, just call for Compucie. They know the computers through and through and can hopefully help you out.

2022-2023.name: Fikscie
2022-2023.description: The name says it all, the Fixcie fixes things. Tables that break by board members jumping on them, the fridges and anything else that is breakable.

2022-2023.name: Fotocie
2022-2023.description: Isn't it lovely to be able to look back on events and see your friends getting drunk? That is why we have the Fotocie, they take pictures at every event so you can always look back and smile at the stupid things that happened.

2022-2023.name: Fraccie
2022-2023.description: The beachparty, a jamsession, maybe a pubquiz, the Fraccie does it all. This committee can do whatever they want, as long as they organise an event for the members. It is always a lot of fun and a great place to make new friends and get to now the other members.

2022-2023.name: Francken Vrij
2022-2023.description: The Francken Vrij is of course Francken's own science magazine. This committee makes sure that there are 3 on your doorstep every year, filled with knowledge and fun.

2022-2023.name: Intercie
2022-2023.description: The Intercie organises 4 events, it can be anything they want it to be, as long as it has to do with sharing culture and nationalities. They might organise a hitch-hicking event or a language workshop, anyway it will be a lot of fun.

2022-2023.name: Representacie
2022-2023.description: To let everyone know that there is an upcoming event, the Representacie makes posters! It is a fun committee that does not need regular meetings and where you can learn a new skill.

2022-2023.name: Sjaarscie
2022-2023.description: The committee for aspiring active Francken members, this is a great way to get to know the association. Together with other first years the Sjaarscie organizes a dinner and a party for fellow first years.

2022-2023.name: Sympcie
2022-2023.description: The Sympcie organises the yearly symposium. This is one of Francken's greatest events and gives you an entire day of learning while enjoying it, so make sure you will be there.

2022-2023.name: Wiecksie
2022-2023.description: Because 5 days of Francken per week isn’t always enough for everyone, for those people there are the members weekends. What can be better then a weekend of relaxation and beer with fellow Francken members? The Wiecksie takes this need seriously and organises two weekends per year full of entertainment.
